active_continuity: Hyuk Sopyung is publicly scorned at Xi’an Tower after his earlier defeat, reflecting the Zhongnan Sect’s declining standing.
Bong-su is Hyuk Sopyung’s same-generation Junior Brother in the Zhongnan Sect.
The Taeeul Sword Unit has come to Xi’an to bring Hyuk Sopyung back.
The Zhongnan Sect’s Second Martial Uncle, the Taeeul Merciless Sword, is in Xi’an and is feared by the sect’s Disciples.
Taekyung successfully performs True Qi Guidance on Jeok Cheongang.
Shared Fire Gate Clan lineage allows Taekyung’s and Jeok Cheongang’s energies to merge without resistance.
The treatment slightly improves Jeok Cheongang’s condition and slightly increases Taekyung’s Scorching Yang Qi.
Taekyung’s Fire Gate Divine Technique reaches seven stars and he levels up after gaining insight from the treatment.
Gung Gibang gathers information at the Beggars’ Sect’s Xi’an branch; it concerns something other than the Divine Physician.
open_questions: What mission brought the Taeeul Sword Unit and the Taeeul Merciless Sword to Xi’an?
What information did Gung Gibang obtain from the Xi’an branch?
temporary_decisions: Use Taeeul Sword Unit for 태을검대.
Use Taeeul Merciless Sword for 태을무정검.
Preserve the Turtle Breath Technique/Ghost Technique pun for 귀식대법 and 귀신대법.
Use Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation Fist for 심폐소생권.
